name: Fast kinetic text
what: A hard-hitting line in three scenes: a short line on black with a warning triangle drawn around it zooms at you until the letters fill the screen with white; a second line comes in word by word on white with a red underline; then a red panel grows out of the left edge, a third line stacks up on it with big faint echoes, a red bar flashes and the last line lands in white.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f9 the first line fades in and a warning triangle with a '!' draws itself; f9-f34 the whole scene zooms at the viewer, accelerating (x1 to x13); f32-f37 white floods the screen; f40-f45 the second line comes in word by word and f41-f49 a red underline slides under it; f49-f62 a red panel grows out of the left edge while f51-f65 a third line stacks up on it, word by word, with big faint echoes; f69-f71 a red bar flashes; f72 the last line lands in white and f84 it grows a little; then it holds
